title: Life event enrollment

blocks.text: A new baby, marriage or adoption lets you change your coverage outside the usual enrollment window, but the clock is short.

items.label: 30 days
items.text: from the marriage, birth or adoption to request medical enrollment for yourself and your dependents.

items.label: 30 days
items.text: after other coverage ends if you or a dependent lose it.

items.label: 60 days
items.text: if state Medicaid or CHIP coverage ends, or you become eligible for premium assistance.

blocks.text: Contact Cigna at 866-494-2111 to request special enrollment. Dental, vision, life and AD&D rules may differ, so confirm with HR.
